💷 Nobody voted for this, and that's rather the point.

The local government finance settlement assumes a 3% core council tax rise plus a 2% adult social care precept — every single year. Do that three times and average band D goes from £2,280 today to around £2,630 by 2028-29. That's an 8.5% increase in REAL terms, on top of inflation.

And for six of the lowest-council-tax authorities — five of them in London and the Home Counties — the government doesn't intend to set a referendum limit at all in 2027-28 or 2028-29. The one democratic check residents have, switched off. 👇
